description: This file defines a PermissionManager utility to handle various system permission checks and requests on macOS, including notifications, accessibility, screen recording, microphone, speech recognition, camera, and location. It also includes helper classes and functions to handle system settings navigation, authorization status querying, and user prompts. The code manages asynchronous permission requests and maintains state through a singleton monitor.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: A singleton class managing asynchronous requests for location permissions, handling delegate callbacks and timeout logic.

classes.name: AppleScriptPermission
classes.description: Manages checks and requests for AppleScript automation permissions using AppleScript execution and opening system settings.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: A singleton class monitoring permission statuses periodically with scheduled timer, used for updating application state.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingProbe
classes.description: Provides static methods to check and request screen recording permission status.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the current location authorization status is sufficient based on the requirement for 'always' authorization.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Performs asynchronous permission checks for a list of capabilities, returning a dictionary with results.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Performs the check or request for a specific capability asynchronously.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of current permission statuses for all capabilities.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens system preferences to the relevant security or privacy pane for user intervention.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location permission, handling user prompts and timeouts.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the location permission request, resumes continuation with current status.

methods.name: locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization
methods.description: Delegate callback when location authorization status changes, marks permission check as complete.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if AppleScript automation permission is granted by executing a benign AppleScript.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Opens system preferences to enable user to authorize AppleScript permissions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers for permission status monitoring, starts the monitoring timer.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters permission status monitoring, stops the timer if no longer needed.

methods.name: refreshNow
methods.description: Forces an immediate permission status check.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Begins periodic permission status polling using a timer.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops the permission status polling timer.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Performs permission status update asynchronously, considering throttling.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if screen recording permission has been granted, based on macOS version.
